negative_reviews.author: R.F.
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) I unfortunately cannot agree with the many positive reviews for the Tonkotsu Ramen. The broth was very thin and not at all creamy, as it should be. It completely lacked complexity in flavor. The meat was sinewy and fatty.

(Original)
Ich kann mich den vielen Bewertungen für den Tonkotsu Ramen leider gar nicht anschließen. Die Brühe war sehr dünn und überhaupt nicht cremig, wie es sein sollte. Es hat komplett Komplexität im Geschmack gefehlt. Das Fleisch war sehnig und fettig.

negative_reviews.author: 刘琳佳
negative_reviews.text: If I could give zero stars for service, I would. We were invisible to the staff—no greeting, no water, no care. They clearly have no problem charging a 10% service fee though, despite doing absolutely nothing to earn it. The food was passable but completely unmemorable. Overall, not worth your time or money.

negative_reviews.author: Bruno Orsini
negative_reviews.text:
(Translated by Google) It must be the worst food in Scotland. Everything tastes stale and old. The spicy broth is made with water and cayenne pepper. Not a single chive. Just don't go.

(Original)
Deve ser a pior comida da Escócia. Tudo com gosto de passado e velho. O caldo apimentado é feito de água e ccayenne. Nenhuma singela cebolinha.  Só não vá.
